Lina (AE): Quick sync w/ customer before POC kickoff. They want CloudHSM-backed BYOK during the 10-day POC. Questions: can we accept imported HSM key material? Who signs off on non-exportability for the POC?
Marco (Solutions): We can support CloudHSM BYOK if we're in Dedicated or Private mode. For Hosted we only support KMS references (no raw key import). Imported HSM material requires their HSM provider paperwork + attestation.
Jordan (Security): To confirm security asks: 1) non-exportability guarantee 2) attestation cert (FIPS 140-2 L3) 3) audit log showing crypto ops. We need to know what we can promise in the SOW.
Ravi (Infra): On non-exportability: Redwood never persists plaintext key material. With customer-managed KMS/HSM the key lives in their HSM and we only call Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey via the KMS endpoint. We can include a contractual clause stating we do not export key material and do not attempt to extract.
Lina (AE): Customer legal asked for a sentence they can review. Do we have standard BYOK language I can paste?
Jordan (Security): Yes - standard clause: "Customer retains sole ownership and control of Customer Key Material. Redwood will only store KMS key identifiers and will not access, export, or persist plaintext key material. All cryptographic operations for Customer Key Material will be performed using the Customer's key in their managed HSM/KMS." Use that as a starting point.
Marco (Solutions): Timeline note: CloudHSM import + attestation often adds 3-5 business days. If they need the POC to start in 10 days and insist on import, we should start import now and run the service in dedicated mode. Alternatively they can use a KMS-generated key (no import) which is faster.
Lina (AE): They prefer import for compliance. I'll ask them to start paperwork. Any billing impact we should flag?
Ravi (Infra): For POC we usually absorb basic infra ops, but HSM import and attestation fees from CloudHSM vendors can be invoiced to the customer if large. Also Dedicated/Private have minimum commit SKUs. I'll attach the standard POC add-on line: "HSM integration effort".
Lina (AE): Customer also wants to ensure rotation is enforced every 90 days, but they want to keep old keys for 180 days for recovery. How will that work?
Marco (Solutions): Typical pattern: rotate by creating a new key version in their KMS and update the KMS arn we call. We keep ciphertext version metadata so we can map to the right key id. If they delete the old key, ciphertext becomes unrecoverable. Recommend disable->schedule-delete after retention period. We can document recovery expectations in SOW.
Jordan (Security): Audit logs: if key lives in their cloud KMS, they already have CloudTrail/Stackdriver logs. For Redwood-managed wrappers we can emit an audit log of each call (user, operation, timestamp) and include that export in the POC deliverable. Need to be explicit about retention window.
Lina (AE): Great. Can we give them a copy/paste IAM policy to grant Redwood access?
Ravi (Infra): Yep. Sample AWS role trust + KMS actions below (replace ids):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::999988887777:role/redwood-poc"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999988887777:key/EXAMPLE-KEY"}
  ]
}
```
Lina (AE): Perfect. I'll send that. Anything else to warn the customer about?
Marco (Solutions): One more: network egress. If Private deployment in their VPC, ensure HSM endpoints are reachable from the instance subnets. If Dedicated we'll need peering/VPN depending on where their HSM lives.
deploy-bot: Action: created ticket POC-3421 label: BYOK-CloudHSM; assignees: Marco,Ravi
Jordan (Security): Also calling out attestation timing in SOW: "Attestation artifacts provided by HSM vendor; Redwood will surface artifacts but vendor timeline may add 2-5 business days."
Lina (AE): I'll fold Jordan's clause and the IAM snippet into the kickoff email. I'll update this thread when they start the import paperwork. :+1:
Marco (Solutions): I'll prepare a brief SOW snippet and pricing note for HSM integration.
Ravi (Infra): Standing by for the role arn and key id.
Lina (AE): Closing loop for now. Thanks everyone.
